text_block_list.text: While walking through the park—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmm~... Nice weather today...
(Plop...)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Was that just now... a carp poking its 
head out? Popping up for food, plop, 
plop... yep.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Yearning for love, carp drift along, food 
come along." ...A senryu from Sei-chan's 
heart, with extra syllables.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san!? Are you slacking off on race 
preparations again...?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, it's just King. I was hoping you'd 
be fish food~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What is that supposed to mean?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Just what it sounds like~ Out for a jog, 
King? You sure are working hard~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am! I have a race coming up, 
after all. And yet, here you are slacking 
off again in a place like this...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, calm down. King, have you ever 
heard of strategic rest?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Just look at the carp in the pond. They're 
swimming leisurely, basking in the 
sunlight, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But... look, see there.

text_block_list.name: Pond Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, fishies, it's feeding time~ 
Come and get it.
(Plop... splash splash splash!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
See? When the moment comes, they swim 
fast. They're building up their strength 
for that right now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Because they swim so calmly in everyday 
moments, carp are sometimes called the 
"Kings of Freshwater."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Kings...?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's right, kings. In other words, my 
resting right now is actually taking 
strategic rest for what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
As King, you surely understand what I 
mean, don't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course! Talk of kings is something I 
understand well! However, even if that's 
the case...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Just needs one more push, huh? In that 
case...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, you over there!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you over there. You heard what we 
said, right? Don't you agree that what I'm 
saying makes total sense~?
choice_data_list: Tell her she's just making excuses

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
See! Even they're nodding along! Right 
now, one should rest with the composure 
befitting a king!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds suspicious coming only from 
Sky-san, but... Well, could that really be 
the case?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe~♪ Well then, King, let's also take 
an active... like a true king would.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No, wait, let's take a strategic rest 
together. Come on, gently close your 
eyes... and take a deep breath...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Yep, feels so peaceful now. It really 
is lovely weather...♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ha! I almost let myself get swept into 
your pace again!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ssskkkyyy-ssaaannn--!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Uh oh, poked the hornet's nest.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I shall allow you to accompany 
me on my jog. Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, King—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
La-la-la! I can't hear anything! Come on, 
move those feet, move!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... It backfired and riled her up 
instead. The schemer drowns in their own 
scheme...

Full of fiery vigor, King Halo dragged 
Seiun Sky along with her.
